characters.summary: Harry Potter is a versatile wizard specializing in defensive and disarming magic, utilizing the Expelliarmus charm and the Patronus Charm. He fights using a holly wand containing a phoenix feather core, backed by high resilience and courage.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to the Killing Curse and dark magic
Deep emotional connection that can be exploited (Occlumency is imperfect)
limitations: Spells require precise wand movements and clear incantations
Physical stamina is that of a normal human teenager
